draft.subject: Your duplicate-project ticket, and a quick next step
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for flagging the 500 error when duplicating larger projects -- that ticket is still open with our team, and Tariq is on it. Sorry for the friction while you're just getting set up.

In the meantime, you've got your first project going in Wrenfield. If it's useful, the next step most teams find worthwhile is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's next with you.

Best,
Priya
